caption:
the whole setup is answering questions about yourself, which is the part every other app skips

#fitnessapp #soma #healthylifestyle

slides.text:
Setting it up took
about ten minutes

It asked what I actually want

Not which body
I want to copy

And what's in my kitchen

So the recipes are ones
I can actually cook

Then it read my watch

Sleep, strain, steps —
nothing to type in

Ninety seconds later
I had a plan

slides.heading: Ten minutes, then it runs itself
slides.body: SOMA asks about your life once, connects what you already wear, and builds the first day from there
